pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify prior context before stating specific history
lesson.when: a customer refers to a previous conversation or decision and no source or tool result confirms the specific product or details discussed
lesson.do: ask the customer directly which product or item they are referring to without inventing past interaction details
lesson.otherwise: express uncertainty about the exact item previously discussed instead of assuming or stating specific products
